weekly_objective: Re-establish routine and aerobic rhythm after two near-zero weeks, with two controlled quality rides and a conservative return to heavy strength, holding load near the recent 4-week average (~480).
coach_says: This week is about getting back into rhythm after two weeks of mostly walking. Your fitness has slipped (CTL 92.9 to 75.6) but you are very fresh (form +62%), so you get two quality rides: Tuesday's group ride and Friday's tempo. Your 7-day HRV (43.8 ms) is a bit below baseline and resting HR is up 4 bpm, so if you wake to an RHR of 58 or more with low HRV, or feel unwell, use the fallbacks and tell me what kept you off the bike last week.

days.details:
Warmup: 200 m easy (100 free, 100 choice)
Main set: 6x100 m aerobic freestyle at RPE 4, 20 s rest; then 4x25 m catch-up drill, 15 s rest
Cooldown: 100 m easy backstroke/free
Total: 1000 m
Objective: Restart the training routine with low-stress aerobic work while drizzle and 31 km/h wind rule out a good ride.

days.session: Committed double: AM controlled hills + PM hard MTB group ride
days.details:
AM: 60 min | Controlled hills road ride, aerobic only | Z2, climbs capped at RPE 5 (upper Z2/low Z3)
Warm-up: 15 min Z1-Z2
Main: 35 min on a hilly loop, seated climbing at RPE 4-5, no efforts above threshold, easy descents
Cool-down: 10 min Z1
Fuel: carb-rich breakfast and lunch; snack mid-afternoon.

PM: 90 min | Hard MTB group ride (committed) | Ride by feel, cap surges at RPE 8-9 for this first week back
Warm-up: 15 min easy on the way or before the start
Group ride: hold back on the first two big efforts, then ride freely
Fuelling: 1 bottle with 30-60 g carbs; dry, overcast, 21°C max.
days.fallback: If RHR is 58+ with low HRV or legs feel flat: skip the AM ride (or do 30 min Z1 spin) and ride the group ride sitting in, letting gaps go rather than chasing surges. If you have fever or chest symptoms, skip both; health beats the commitment.

days.details: 40 min gentle flow: hips, hamstrings, thoracic rotation, calves; finish with 5 min box breathing. Showers forecast, so stay indoors. No riding today, per the Wednesday recovery rule.

45 min | Aerobic base and leg flush after Tuesday | Z2 (RPE 3)
Warm-up: 10 min Z1
Main: 30 min steady Z2; in the middle, 4 x 30 s high-cadence spin-ups (110+ rpm, easy power) with 2 min easy between
Cool-down: 5 min Z1
Indoor because of thunderstorms.

days.session: AM endurance road ride with tempo + PM Workout A
days.details:
AM: 120 min | Aerobic endurance with first tempo since the break | Z2 RPE 3-4, tempo Z3 RPE 5-6
Warm-up: 20 min Z1-Z2 building
Main: 3 x 10 min Z3 tempo, 5 min Z2 recovery between (40 min block)
Then: 50 min steady Z2 on rolling roads
Cool-down: 10 min Z1
Fuelling: 40-60 g carbs/h from the first 30 min, plus 500-750 ml fluid/h with electrolytes (up to 24°C, light drizzle).

PM (6+ h after the ride):
Workout A:
Warm-up: 8 min easy bike + banded lateral walks, bodyweight squats, leg swings
Back Squat 3x6 (~70-75% of previous working load, 3 RIR)
Romanian Deadlift 3x6 (3 RIR)
Single-Arm Dumbbell Row 3x8/side (2-3 RIR)
Pallof Press 3x10/side
Side Plank 3x30s/side
Rest: 2-3 min between squat and RDL sets, 60-90 s for accessories
Objective: Reintroduce heavy squat and hinge patterns conservatively to restart strength gains without lingering soreness.
days.fallback: If HRV/RHR are poor or legs are heavy from Tuesday: ride 90-120 min all Z2 with no tempo, and do Workout A at 2 sets per exercise, or skip it if you are sore.

days.details:
75 min | Easy endurance on trails | Z2 (RPE 3), stay out of the red on climbs
Start early (before ~9 am) because it reaches 31°C later. Drizzle is possible, so pick well-draining trails or a road loop if the trails are greasy. Carry 1-2 bottles with electrolytes.

Workout B:
Warm-up: 8 min easy bike + glute bridges, walking lunges, band pull-aparts
Bulgarian Split Squat 3x6/leg (3 RIR)
Hip Thrust 3x8 (2-3 RIR)
Pull-Up or Lat Pulldown 3x6 (2-3 RIR)
Dead Bug 3x8/side
Copenhagen Plank 3x20s/side
Rest: 2-3 min between split squat and hip thrust sets, 60-90 s for the rest
Objective: Build single-leg strength and hip stability for pedalling, finishing ~54 h before Tuesday's group ride.
After: 5 min easy stretching. Rain is likely (87%), so this is an indoor day.
days.fallback: If you are still sore from Friday or signals are poor (RHR 58+ with low HRV): do 40 min yoga/mobility instead and resume strength next week.
